metaDescription: USM Var 41 corn is a yellow open pollinated corn variety. About 102 days to harvest, 7.7 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: USM Var 41 corn is a yellow open pollinated corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2016 as *NSIC 2016 Cn 307. USMARC, Kabacan North, Cotabato bred it. It takes about 102 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.74 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about USM Var 41 corn
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

USM Var 41 corn takes about 102 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 28 yellow open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 101.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.74 t/ha beats the average of its group, 5.88. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against corn earworm, so scout for it from the early weeks. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 16.8 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 77 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant USM Var 41 corn

It is recommended for the Visayas and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 102 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.74 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.
It is recommended for the Visayas and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of USM Var 41?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
